name: biggen_gemini3_v1
status: FINALIZED biggen judge config (lowest false-pass + highest MCC + cheapest)
adapter_note: v1 = evidence-first (JSON order: evidence, rationale, verdict). Beats v4 on biggen; opposite of tutorbench, where analysis-first (v4) helped. Config is benchmark-specific.
max_tokens_note: Gold scored at 4096 (0 unscorable on the 100-cell gold, so the FP=0% budget is truncation-clean and transfers). PRODUCTION uses 6144: on the full biggen matrix, 4096 still truncated ~2.4% of cells -> fake fails; 6144 -> ~0.09%. regrade_benchmark.py auto-bumps gemini-3 to 6144.
parser: regex verdict extraction ("verdict":"pass|fail") with json.loads fallback; fail-closed
auto_fail_policy: generation error / empty / missing -> fail WITHOUT a judge call; length-truncated -> graded
optimal_concurrency_note: gateway soft-throttles past ~256 (see FINDINGS); use ~256 for bulk runs
selection_rationale: HANDOFF headline is false-pass: gemini-3 FP 0.0% (weighted 0.0%), highest MCC 0.866, 0 unscorable, ~5x cheaper than sonnet. Tradeoff: higher false-fail (15.6%). All candidates beat the frozen Qwen baseline.
